title: What a fascinating time to be alive …
excerpt: Here we are, celebrating the 2008th anniversary of the birth of Jesus … and we’re still arguing like cats and dogs about who Jesus is and what he’s about. Here’s my post over at Progressive Revival on the reent Warren-Obama-Haggard-Cizik kerfuffles …
body:
